text: われわれも　どんどん　つよく　なりたいものだな

structure.jp: どんどん　つよく　なりたいものだな
structure.en: would really like to keep getting stronger

patterns.name: 〜たいものだ
patterns.explanation: たい means 'want to', and adding ものだ makes it a heartfelt wish. つよく　なりたいものだ = 'I do so want to become strong'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く, plus なる, means 'become that'. つよく　なりたい = 'want to become strong'.
